result.title: An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction
result.summary: In practical engineering and scientific computing, a real physical system can be reduced to a boundary value problem, and the adequate boundary information to determine the interior spatial distribution and evolutionary state of the physical field can be solved with linear equations, alternatively, the the real physical problem can be treated with boundary problems with in adequate information problems in field of machine learning. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for the recovery of missing boundary information using an attention-guided graph neural network (GNN) surrogate. The framework extracts features from the physical information on the discretized boundary into a latent space, and the missing boundary quantities are then predicted by the network. Thus, the nonlinear mapping from known boundary quantities to missing boundary quantities is learned using a variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to better model the correlations among different types of boundary information. Furthermore, the interior physical field can be reconstructed using the conventional boundary element method (BEM) integral formulation. The effectiveness of the GNN-BEM framework is evaluated using numerical examples of the two-dimensional Laplace and Poisson equations, which demonstrate good performance in reconstruction accuracy, local detail preservation, and model stability. The results show that GNN-BEM provides a feasible computational framework for boundary information recovery and fast interior physical field reconstruction for partial differential equations under complex boundary conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GNN-BEM 框架，用注意力引导的图神经网络加 VAE，将离散边界上的物理量编码到 latent 空间，由已知边界量预测缺失边界量，再用传统边界元积分重建内部物理场，在二维 Laplace 与 Poisson 方程数值算例上验证重建精度与稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接交集，但其「由部分可观测边界信息推断缺失信息并重建内部状态」的 latent 空间设定及注意力建模变量间关联的做法，可能与 LVR 中证据不完整时内部状态如何承载并补全任务必要信息的表述有概念呼应，可供核查。
